title: Phase 11 — Score, Lives and Bombs
summary: Phase 11 requirements: enemy points, score and high score in the HUD and cookie, checkpoint score, bombs and their controls, extra life and bomb bonuses, and the test API.
notes: Path under specs/ gives a strong SPEC signal. Content is PRD-like: P11-R01..R08 with acceptance criteria, goal and out-of-scope sections, user-facing behaviour. Status is Ready, not an ADR, so locked is false.
